product_one_liner.value: Smallest.ai provides real-time speech models and voice agents for enterprises and developers building conversational voice applications.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage positions the product as an enterprise-scale voice AI suite, while its documentation describes speech models, hosted voice agents, SDKs, and APIs: https://smallest.ai/ and https://docs.smallest.ai/.

pricing_page.notes: A public model-pricing page exists at https://smallest.ai/pricing/models.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company publishes customer stories describing Pocket’s use of Pulse and Kogta’s collections deployment: https://smallest.ai/pocket and https://smallest.ai/customer-stories/kogta. | named_customers.0: The Pocket customer page describes its product as powered by Smallest’s Pulse. | named_customers.1: The Kogta case study describes its use of Smallest AI for collections calls.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 105 employees, which falls in the 101–200 band: https://inc42.com/company/smallest-ai/people. This is a third-party headcount rather than a company-confirmed count.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s LinkedIn profile explicitly lists San Francisco, California as its headquarters: https://linkedin.com/company/smallest. | hq_country: The company’s LinkedIn profile identifies its headquarters as San Francisco, California, and gives the country as US: https://linkedin.com/company/smallest.

founded_year.notes: The CEO’s company biography explicitly says he started Smallest AI in 2023: https://smallest.ai/author/sudarshan-kamath.

eng_blog.notes: Two posts discuss the company’s own model engineering: hardware co-optimization in https://smallest.ai/blog/rewriting-tts-inference-economics-lightning-v2-on-tenstorrent-achieves-4%C3%97-lower-cost-than-nvidia-l40s and streaming-model evaluation in https://smallest.ai/blog/introducing-lightning-v3. Their authors are respectively an AI inference performance engineer and the company’s TTS research-and-development team. The second attribution is collective rather than a named individual.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal links to voice-agent documentation, model documentation, and API references with schemas and code examples: https://docs.smallest.ai/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public job board lists Senior SDET, Software Engineer—Systems and Reliability Engineering, and Manager—Finance and Accounts. None has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/smallest. This negative is based on the board’s listed openings.

model_provider.value: Smallest AI, including its in-house Lightning v3.1 text-to-speech model.
model_provider.notes: The Lightning v3.1 model card identifies Smallest AI as its developer, and the company’s author biography identifies its internal TTS research-and-development team: https://docs.smallest.ai/models/model-cards/text-to-speech/lightning-v-3-1 and https://smallest.ai/author/smallest-ai.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company publicly claims SOC 2, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance in its footer at https://smallest.ai/careers. These are reported as public claims, not independent confirmation of current certification validity. | compliance_certs.0: The company footer explicitly claims SOC 2 compliance. | compliance_certs.1: The company footer explicitly claims HIPAA compliance. | compliance_certs.2: The company footer explicitly claims GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding announcement explicitly identifies the round as Series A: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/smallestai-gets-21-million-in-funding-to-build-voice-4-0--the-next-generation-of-enterprise-voice-ai-302839266.html. | funding_date: The announcement dated July 30, 2026 reports the closing of the Series A, supporting 2026-07 as the publicly announced funding month: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/smallestai-gets-21-million-in-funding-to-build-voice-4-0--the-next-generation-of-enterprise-voice-ai-302839266.html. | funding_amount_usd: The July 30, 2026 announcement identifies the Series A round as $13 million; more than $21 million is cumulative funding, not the round amount: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/smallestai-gets-21-million-in-funding-to-build-voice-4-0--the-next-generation-of-enterprise-voice-ai-302839266.html.

raised_18mo.notes: The $13 million Series A announced July 30, 2026 falls within the preceding 18 months: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/smallestai-gets-21-million-in-funding-to-build-voice-4-0--the-next-generation-of-enterprise-voice-ai-302839266.html.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The direct BDR—GTM & Outbound, US posting remains readable with an application link: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/smallest/d5f015ce-7470-4930-9cb3-fc7a930a039b. Confidence is reduced because this posting is omitted from the general job-board listing.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 5, 2026 Lightning V3 announcement states that the model is available that day. This substantial model launch falls within the six-month window: https://smallest.ai/blog/introducing-lightning-v3.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The November 6, 2026 announcement names Siddharth Sharma President of BFSI, India, owning revenue and partnerships and working directly with the CEO. This is treated as a qualifying senior-executive-level appointment; the exact title is President rather than a named C-officer or VP: https://www.aninews.in/news/business/smallest-ai-names-ex-cred-yes-bank-kotak-digital-banking-leader-siddharth-sharma-president-8211-bfsi-india20261106154941.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The company’s BDR posting explicitly names Zoho as its CRM and Instantly, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Aurasell as sales tools: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/smallest/d5f015ce-7470-4930-9cb3-fc7a930a039b. | crm_stack_signal.0: The BDR posting explicitly labels Zoho as the CRM. | crm_stack_signal.1: Instantly is explicitly listed among the sales tools. | crm_stack_signal.2: LinkedIn Sales Navigator is explicitly listed among the sales tools. | crm_stack_signal.3: Aurasell is explicitly listed among the sales tools.
